question: Which of the following is the main property of the OR gate?

options.text: It produces a high output when at least one input is high.
It produces a low output only when all inputs are high.
It produces a high output only when all inputs are low.
It produces a low output when at least one input is low.

solution:
__**Explanation:**__

The OR gate operates based on the principle of logical addition. The output of the OR gate will be high (1) if one or more of its inputs are high (1). Conversely, the output will be low (0) only when all its inputs are low (0). This behavior can be summarized in its truth table, as shown below:
